sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Still no change to the gameplay. All my clicks are just advancing the HUD timer. I need to fundamentally reconsider what this game is about.
Let me look at the image again. The blue blob at the bottom - is it really a player? Or is it part of the puzzle? The white panel with the checkerboard and slots - maybe this is a "camera" or "frame" and the blue blob is something else.
Wait - looking at the image more carefully, the white panel looks like a polaroid photo! The checkerboard is the "photo" and below it are the slots. The blue blob is outside the frame.
Maybe the goal is to recreate the pattern shown in the "photo" (the checkerboard with yellow shapes) onto the slots below? Or maybe I need to click on the checkerboard tiles to change their color to match some pattern?
Let me try a completely different approach: click on individual checkerboard tiles to see if they change color. The checkerboard has alternating black and charcoal tiles. Let me click on a charcoal tile and see if it changes.
Actually, let me look at the slots more carefully. The slots below the checkerboard have:
- Left slot: black top bar, black vertical support
- Middle slot: black top bar, black vertical support  
- Right slot: light gray top bar, light gray vertical support
These look like they could be "pedestals" or "stands" that hold something. The yellow objects on the checkerboard might need to be "moved" to these slots.
But how? If clicking doesn't work... Maybe I need to click on the white panel area to select it, then click on the slots?
Or maybe the game requires clicking on specific checkerboard tiles to change the pattern?
Let me try clicking on a single checkerboard tile (not on a yellow object) to see if tiles can be toggled.
